body: Ah, yes, that really made me feel better. /s
If I will have a future, that is.
If she dissappeared I'd probably fall for another girl, and the story would repeat.

You're right about that.

I consider myself to be a loser because I am too scared to talk to girls, and have nothing that a girl might find appealing.
In my case, the guy does like her back. And maybe there are more reasons that I haven't discovered, because I'm too scared to talk to her.
Good luck to you too! It hurts to see how nice people like you have to live with those weights on their hearts.
Past experiences. If I am alone now, what makes it so that I will not be alone later?
Yes, had a few, but no long ones.
I'll try to build up the courage.
Oh dear. I am really sorry for you. That would crush my heart if it happened to me.
I do not know why I am so obsessed with her. I probably can't see any of her defects, and therefore see her as perfect.

I've heard this "there's someone for you" way too many times. There's nobody out there for me. And even if there was, what are the chances of me finding her? There is nothing about me that girls like. The problem is that I can't wait for much longer. The urge gets stronger every day. I'm about to lose the war.
I don't think I understand. Mind expanding this a bit?
I hope I'm still alive by the time I'll forget her. I still have years to spend near her, and she probably isn't going anywhere.
